question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
-- Final query - clean output with just the required columns
WITH orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, order_time, pizza_id, exclusions, extras) as row_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT r.pizza_id, t2.topping_name
    FROM pizza_recipes r
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(TRIM(r.toppings), ',')) AS t(top_id)
    JOIN pizza_toppings t2 ON t2.topping_id = TRY_CAST(t.top_id AS INTEGER)
),
excluded_toppings AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, et.topping_name
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT t2.topping_name
        FROM UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(TRIM(o.exclusions), ',')) AS t(top_id)
        JOIN pizza_toppings t2 ON t2.topping_id = TRY_CAST(t.top_id AS INTEGER)
    ) AS et ON TRUE
),
extra_toppings AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, et.topping_name
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT t2.topping_name
        FROM UNNEST(STRING_SPLIT(TRIM(o.extras), ',')) AS t(top_id)
        JOIN pizza_toppings t2 ON t2.topping_id = TRY_CAST(t.top_id AS INTEGER)
    ) AS et ON TRUE
),
all_ingredients AS (
    SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.order_time, pn.pizza_name,
           st.topping_name as ingredient, 'standard' as type
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    JOIN standard_toppings st ON st.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.order_time, pn.pizza_name,
           et.topping_name as ingredient, 'excluded' as type
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    JOIN excluded_toppings et ON et.row_id = o.row_id
    WHERE et.topping_name IS NOT NULL AND et.topping_name != ''
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT o.row_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.pizza_id, o.order_time, pn.pizza_name,
           et.topping_name as ingredient, 'extra' as type
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    JOIN extra_toppings et ON et.row_id = o.row_id
    WHERE et.topping_name IS NOT NULL AND et.topping_name != ''
),
net_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           ingredient,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'standard' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as std_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'excluded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as excl_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'extra' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as extra_count
    FROM all_ingredients
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name, ingredient
),
final_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           ingredient,
           GREATEST(std_count - excl_count + extra_count, 0) as final_qty
    FROM net_ingredients
    WHERE GREATEST(std_count - excl_count + extra_count, 0) > 0
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           ingredient, final_qty,
           CASE WHEN final_qty > 1 THEN CAST(final_qty AS VARCHAR) || 'x' ELSE '' END as prefix,
           CASE WHEN final_qty > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_multi
    FROM final_ingredients
),
sorted_ingredients AS (
    SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name,
           ingredient, final_qty, prefix, is_multi,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY row_id ORDER BY is_multi DESC, ingredient ASC) as sort_order
    FROM formatted
)
SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name,
       pizza_name || ': ' || STRING_AGG(prefix || ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY sort_order) as ingredients
FROM sorted_ingredients
GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, pizza_name
ORDER BY row_id
